title: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations

entities.name: Elspeth Calderwood
entities.description: A planeswalker and warrior who knows Mirrodin from the earlier war; she is immune to Phyrexian infection and reunites with Koth.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker on the strike team who can shift into phase with others and finds Kaito's tanuki drone and sword.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: A planeswalker and geomancer who leads Mirran Resistance forces and will join the descent with a demolition team.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A telepathic planeswalker who leads the strike team's plan to deliver the sylex to the Seedcore.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: An ancient lithomancer planeswalker whose infection is discovered by Melira; she hides it and chooses to fight on.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker from Kamigawa who recovers his sword and tanuki drone and hones his blade with hexgold.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: A planeswalker and prince who despises Phyrexia's mockery of a World Tree and seeks Glimmervoid metal.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A Mirran healer immune to infection who explains Mirrodin's layers and treats Nahiri.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian leader who rules from the Fair Basilica and whose World Tree she calls Realmbreaker.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: The praetor of the Quiet Furnace, who allows the Mirrans to live in the Furnace Layer and leads a rebellion against Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Thrun
entities.description: A troll who broke a hole in the shell of the plane and dropped a rope ladder.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker whose plan the strike team follows; he has not been seen since arrival.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A planeswalker who destroyed the last sylex and has not been seen since the team arrived.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker who was shunted away by a trap after the team gathered.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who was not with the group when they woke.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A planeswalker whose whereabouts are unknown.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A planeswalker whose unpredictable spark makes her flicker before she departs for the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The planeswalker who used the first sylex.

entities.name: Pompon
entities.description: Kaito's small tanuki-shaped robot, found by Kaya and returned to him.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The compleated plane the strike team is invading.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The original metal plane layered sphere within sphere; what remains of the original is the layer called Mirrex.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Kaito's home plane, which Phyrexian infiltration already threatens.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nahiri's home plane.

entities.name: Furnace Layer
entities.description: A burning layer of magma and pyroclastic shelves where the Mirran Resistance camps at Urabrask's pleasure.

entities.name: Lacuna
entities.description: A gravity-shifting tunnel sustained by nurturing magic that leads from Mirrodin down to the Furnace Layer.

entities.name: Seedcore
entities.description: The center of the plane where the sylex must be set off to destroy Realmbreaker.

entities.name: Fair Basilica
entities.description: Elesh Norn's stronghold, above the Seedcore.

entities.name: Dross Pits
entities.description: The layer directly above the Fair Basilica that includes the old Mephidross.

entities.name: Mycosynth Gardens
entities.description: The layer where Phyrexia seeded fungus that spread contamination through Mirrodin.

entities.name: Hunter Maze
entities.description: A layer beneath the Furnace Layer to be bypassed.

entities.name: Surgical Bay
entities.description: A layer beneath the Hunter Maze to be bypassed.

entities.name: Monumental Facade
entities.description: The outermost shell Phyrexia built around Mirrodin.

entities.name: Glimmervoid
entities.description: A place on Mirrex from which the Mirrans scavenge metal plates to make hexgold.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: Elesh Norn's name for the corrupt World Tree that will connect New Phyrexia to the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: The sylex
entities.description: A powerful bomb the strike team will plant at the roots of the World Tree to destroy it.

entities.name: Hexgold
entities.description: A rare metal refined from Glimmervoid plates with blinkmoth serum that offers some protection against phyresis and sharpens weapons against the compleated.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: A scarce, untested means of escaping Phyrexian infection.

entities.name: The Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes through which the World Tree is meant to connect.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The compleated horde that rules New Phyrexia and attacks the planeswalkers.

entities.name: The Resistance
entities.description: The surviving Mirrans fighting Phyrexia from the Furnace Layer.

events.summary: Elspeth wakes alone on New Phyrexia and fights off six Phyrexians until Kaya joins her.
events.quote: a purple-tinged blade thrust through a Phyrexian heart

events.summary: Elspeth and Kaya descend through the lacuna with Kaya carrying a stray tanuki-shaped robot.
events.quote: From there, they had continued toward the white lacuna

events.summary: Elspeth and Kaya emerge from the lacuna into the Furnace Layer and spot the Mirran camp.
events.quote: True to its name, the Furnace Layer burned .

events.summary: Elspeth is reunited with Koth, whom she thought dead.
events.quote: Koth, I thought you were dead!

events.summary: Kaya reunites with Tyvar and Jace, who explains the barrier broke the mindlink and the strike force is scattered.
events.quote: The barrier broke that link, along with so many other things.

events.summary: Jace says Nissa was shunted away by a trap, as if forced to planeswalk again.
events.quote: a trap shunted her away

events.summary: Kaya returns Kaito's sword to him and the tanuki drone leaps back to his shoulder.
events.quote: untying the blade and slapping the hilt into Kaito's palm

events.summary: Jace states that the plan stays the same: get the sylex to the base of the World Tree before it connects through the Blind Eternities.
events.quote: If we don't get the sylex to the base of their World Tree before it connects through the Blind Eternities, all the planes will share Mirrodin's fate.

events.summary: Melira reveals Elesh Norn calls the tree her Realmbreaker.
events.quote: Elesh Norn calls it her Realmbreaker.

events.summary: Elspeth, hearing Karn and Ajani are missing, notes that both know too much about the sylex.
events.quote: Ajani destroyed the last one.

events.summary: Melira demands honesty about what the sylex will do to Mirrodin, arguing her people have already survived the end of their plane.
events.quote: Your plane doesn't matter so much more than ours that I'm going to help you sacrifice what little we have left.

events.summary: Using Nahiri's stone shaping, Melira builds a model of Mirrodin's nested layers, showing the Seedcore at its center.
events.quote: This is the Seedcore,

events.summary: Melira explains the Mycosynth Gardens fungus and how Phyrexia took Mirrodin, and the Fair Basilica as Elesh Norn's stronghold.
events.quote: They seeded the center of our plane with fungus that pumped Phyrexian contamination into the air

events.summary: Koth explains the route down through the Hunter Maze and Surgical Bay to land in the Dross Pits above the Fair Basilica.
events.quote: We'll bypass both to land in the Dross Pits, directly above the Fair Basilica.

events.summary: Koth describes the Mirrans' dire survival and resolve; Elspeth apologizes for leaving.
events.quote: As long as one of us is breathing, we'll keep fighting back.

events.summary: Jace admits he is not sure the plane will survive the sylex but says there is no time for a new plan.
events.quote: No. No, I'm not.

events.summary: Jace confesses the plan is to set off a bomb in the center of the plane, and Melira agrees to help provided they do not lie about the risk.
events.quote: We're setting off a bomb in the center of the plane.

events.summary: Koth introduces hexgold, a Mirran metal that protects somewhat against phyresis, and offers it for the team's gear.
events.quote: Our gear has been treated with a substance we call hexgold.

events.summary: Jace explains that Urabrask, praetor of the Quiet Furnace, tolerates the Mirrans and his chaos may be the key to success.
events.quote: Urabrask is the praetor of the Quiet Furnace.

events.summary: Kaito and Tyvar prepare their weapons with hexgold.
events.quote: breaking his sword into its individual throwing stars

events.summary: Koth announces he will join the descent with a demolition team as a backup if the sylex fails.
events.quote: I have a demolition team standing by to do what needs to be done if your sylex fails.

events.summary: Nahiri removes her bandage and reveals the Phyrexian spike growing from her neck; Melira, who suspected, confronts her.
events.quote: revealing the blunt, hardened spike growing there

events.summary: Nahiri cuts the spike open and tries hexgold powder, which fails to cure her.
events.quote: It didn't work,

events.summary: Melira offers to heal Nahiri but warns it would sideline her for days; Nahiri chooses to fight on, with Melira to heal her later.
events.quote: So we fight now, and I heal you later.

events.summary: Jace and Kaya leave by hand-pumped cart into the tunnel to the Dross Pits, and the rest follow.
events.quote: made her own descent into the shadows of New Phyrexia

relations.note: fight together and Kaya calls her sunshine
relations.quote: It can't be too much farther from here, sunshine,
There's an air to people who're still holding on to the hope that they're wrong, and you had it,
there was no love lost between Jace and Nahiri

relations.note: his rebellion is hoped to distract her
relations.quote: We're hoping Urabrask's rebellion will keep her distracted

relations.note: Mirran healer fighting with the Resistance
relations.quote: My people have already made it through the end of our plane.

relations.note: has a demolition team standing by
relations.quote: I have a demolition team standing by

relations.note: a layer inside the nested plane
relations.quote: We'll bypass both to land in the Dross Pits, directly above the Fair Basilica.
